text:
## Assessment — ALARM for severity, cause unresolved

- **Measured severity is valid:** channel s1, washer front panel, **24.77 mm/s RMS**, ISO 20816 Class I **Zone D**. `scale_calibrated=true`, so absolute ISO severity is reportable.
- **Speed identification is the blocker:** Bayesian posterior is multimodal with **p_map = 0.308 (<0.80)**: 494.3 rpm (p=0.315), 520.9 rpm (p=0.308, 68% CI 516.9–523.3 rpm), 866.5 rpm (p=0.180), 944.4 rpm (p=0.196). This conflicts with the audio blade-pass track of **74.19 Hz / 4451 rpm**. Capture is 30 fps with **15.0 Hz Nyquist** and a near-Nyquist warning, so shaft harmonics alias. A generic-machine kinematic what-if returned an identical posterior, so the machine-class assumption does not resolve it. No `display_rpm` was read for an independent check.
- **Resonance / looseness not supported:** resonance P=0.030 (prior 0.12, critical-in-range evidence −6.5 dB, `campbell_criticals=[]`); looseness P=0.0056 (shaft-harmonic evidence −8.7 dB). The only mode is **2.34 ± 0.23 Hz** from the residual spectrum with damping **ζ = null**, insufficient for a resonance conclusion.
- **Not evaluable — do not act on priors:** imbalance (P=0.15), misalignment (P=0.10), flow (P=0.10), bearing (P=0.08) all have `evaluable:false`. I need a tach-confirmed steady speed with 1× amplitude/phase, axial + cross-coupling phase for misalignment, and sampling above bearing frequencies.
- **No cavitation/impact evidence:** cavitation index 0.039, HF energy fraction 0.0048, audio `cavitation_like=false`, `rubbing_or_impacts=false`. Audio confirms tumble, a spin-up at ~00:13–00:16, then a steady spin plateau.

## Optimisation — conditional proposal `p34380`, human approval required

Optimiser (80% minimum duty, 10% resonance margin) is feasible but anchored to the disputed 4451 rpm track: **4451 → 3564 rpm**, feasible band 3564–4451 rpm, exclusion bands 63–77 rpm and 127–155 rpm (≥10% from 70 rpm 2× and 141 rpm 1× on 2.3 Hz), P(resonance)=0% vs 5% threshold, expected **−19.9% twin vibration** and **−48.7% electrical power (0.100 → 0.051 kW)** at 80% duty. No NPSH data applies to this washer drive.

**Hold approval:** the twin predicts ~0.0001 mm/s versus the measured 24.77 mm/s Zone D, so it does not reproduce the asset and no ISO improvement is claimed. Confirm speed first with a tachometer/display-RPM capture and a higher-rate recording of the steady spin segment, then re-run the optimiser.
